statement: Summoning unlocks in world 6 with two sections: star map for upgrades and Summoner table for battles plus winner bonuses rewards.
Initially only the nine white battles are available and each is a one-time completion.
Two major stats: essence gain and experience multiplier; seven essence colors: white green yellow blue purple red cyan.
Essence numbers get high but star map costs scale up quite high too.
Star map starts with one white box; spending one level in a box unlocks the next box.
Every color has two essence generation boxes plus a box unlocking the next color (green from white).
General rule across colors: level essence gain first; keep other stats relatively balanced since even the worst stat beats nothing.
White essence champ gives white essence per win across all colors; only white counts all colors so big early white bonus.
White knowledge gives white essence based on summoning level so keep leveling the skill.
Familiar is next white priority: buy 10 familiars every 4 days; buy as many as you can for experience.
Three blue slimes merge into a vomey (green slime) and four of those merge into a bloomy and so on.
Base familiar gives 10 exp/hour; three slimes give 30 then times 4 gives 120 exp/hour per vomey; buy every 4 days methodically.
Priority: essence first then equal priority on max-level skills like familiar merging multi-number cards and dodge roll.
Max-level upgrades are mana generation or max-level cards; afterwards catch up unit health and unit damage.
Level green summoning stone as much as possible with white essence balanced with other white skills; gives initial green essence and unlocks green battles.
Green essence victory gives essence per green circuit win; green knowledge scales with summoning level.
Mana overflow is huge: when mana hits max in battle it multiplies max mana by 1.5 and generates mana faster; level ASAP.
Roomie unit has about 10 upgrades and 7% chance to draw; more speed damage and dodge; bigger slime for battles.
Next priority is starting mana: more initial mana allows initial burst to win before waves get crazy.
Equal priority: yellow essence summoning to start yellow generation and spike placement which damages mobs directly by clicking.
Health and damage are last priority but worth leveling to about the same point as other skills or slightly below.
Yellow stone gives yellow essence; yellow essence winning gives more per yellow win and more per summoning level.
Max out talents with max level: luck of the draw gives more special units; slime cell split gives chance to duplicate.
Redraw lets you skip bad draws saving mana; another slot is a nice bonus; sharpen spikes multiplies spike placement; all three relatively important.
Level up blue summoning as much as possible then health and damage.
Bloomy is one of the best slimes giving 40% mana generation each; with jeweled card 4 or 8 bloomies give up to 160% mana generation.
Bloomies are probably more important than leveling yellow essence winning though more essence unlocks bloomies faster later.
Blue summoning unlocks blue stone and initial essence; blue essence boosting adds blue circuit win essence and blue knowledge adds summoning level essence.
Slime mitosis gives another chance to double (four times instead of one); another slot gives five summon cards instead of three.
Jeweled mobs cost more mana but spawn four times as many units; one of the best things to get.
Jeweled cards can cost you the win if you lack enough mana generation to keep up.
Purple summoning is next priority to unlock purple circuit and start generating purple essence.
Mana roar gives more mana generation; equal priority with Tonka.
Tonka isn't personally useful to him but has eight times HP of base slimes; tanky mob to push back waves.
Health and damage for slimes is last priority.
Purple essence pumping gives more purple essence per circuit win and per summoning level.
Familiar skipping is first purple priority: free summoning experience via chance to spawn vomey or bloomy instead of basic slime.
Bloomy equals 12 basic slimes; base chance of a bloomy is 1 in 50; worth leveling for experience.
Next go straight to red summoning for red essence per hour with major bonuses; costly so may not afford immediately.
Final card gives 3% more mana generation for every card played and stacks as you spend your hand.
Mana dividends gives more mana generation.
Regalis spawns more basic blue slimes but is very expensive to summon; consider skipping until later if mana generation is low.
Purple gives percent to damage and yellow gives percent to HP but you need base numbers for percent to matter.
Red and cyan are new colors from recent update with major damage and HP multipliers; look here if stuck on damage.
Red section starts with red essence regeneration for circuit wins and summoning level.
Unlock cyan summoning as soon as possible since cyan bonuses are bigger than red.
Other red buffs are about equal; cost crashing is first priority as it discounts everything else on the board.
Cost crashing at level 50 gives him 34% cost reduction.
Sparky next: new mob doing a lot of damage that explodes with huge knockback to push mobs out of the way.
Slime duplication next for another chance to duplicate slimes helping with massive later waves.
Seeing red gives damage buff each time you take damage; with 15 health to lose that is 150% damage.
Using seeing red strategically by letting a few mobs through can turn tides but don't get overwhelmed.
Red and cyan percent damage/HP are new multipliers; his damage went from a few thousand under 10000 to 125000.
Keep red and cyan upgrades balanced across the whole board.
Cyan essence king gives cyan essence per circuit win and cyan knowledge by summoning level; no new color unlock at cyan.
Ignore the three far-right cyan bonuses tied to endless summoning until you can afford them cheaply; upgrade slowly later.
Eye frames gives chance to dodge taking no damage; 30% for him.
Cyan damage multiplier is 240% at level 24 at 10% per level.
Cost deflation gives 52% cost reduction on star map upgrades at level 54.
Undying units is percent HP bonus to all units giving his 371k HP; one level raises to 377k.
Two cyan multipliers boost summon damage and HP by percentage for every 100 total summoning upgrades purchased; he's at about 480.
HP laundering gives HP based on total summoning upgrades purchased.
Summary: level essence first max out max-level bonuses keep everything even in cost focus on mana generation then damage and HP last.
Summoner table colors correspond to star map colors unlocked; initially only white with nine battles.
White arena is a narrow three-row strip with low HP and damage mobs; easy wins until about white 5 to 7.
White 8 and 9 are harder until you get stats from other colors; may clear green battles before white 7 so bounce between colors.
Each color from green through blue adds another square of space; purple battles change mob speed.
Red and cyan battles have a knockback penalty so you need to upgrade stats to clear them.
Main strategy: summon mobs along the lane to block incoming mobs and click for spike damage while having mana.
Each win gives a chest with a new bonus added to the bottom list; same bonuses stack.
Strategy one: summon where mobs come out to hold waves back and click on them; legitimate way if you have enough damage.
Strategy two cheese: start the match and summon everything on the bottom row; not recommended unless desperate for more battles.
Cheese strategy is RNG dependent on mob spawns and knockback; works even with about a tenth of the enemy stats.
Real strategy: let mana build up then summon when mobs get close; can take basic damage for damage bonus.
Then summon everywhere using spike trap overwhelming mobs; gives lots of purple mana generation and bloomies on map.
Use redraw to get a different mob spawn when mobs are expensive; click mobs so spike trap damages as you summon and mana stacks.
Cheese strategy: as soon as battle starts summon as fast as possible on bottom or top row to get through mobs before they stack.
Red and cyan have anti-knockback bonus making cheese strategy harder but still possible.
Fight battles you know you can win since each win has a chance to give hearts back extending your daily streak.
Every win gives a bonus; some bonuses are duplicated and stack across several wins.
25x total damage is made of seven or eight bonuses; bonuses include farming and sneaking jade gain essence gain skill exp drop rate AFK gain cooking speed skilling efficiency.
Favorite winner bonus is 9.68x construction speed making Wizard Towers shrines and construction levels much easier.
Last bonus from 14th cyan wave gives +10 max Library level for talent levels.
His max library level is 280 after the bonus.
World 1 has four summoning stamps: white essence stamp; Triad essence stamp for green yellow blue; dark Triad essence for purple red cyan.
Fourth stamp gives summoning experience from a quest at end of world 6 in the leak map from sussy genie NPC.
Quest is difficult and requires getting 2500 mana in a single battle.
Essence statue gives more white essence; can be Onyx and buy gold statue at end for more white essence.
Bamboo Spirit card gives summoning experience up to 18% at Ruby.
One star sign gives summoning experience; card plus star sign total 38%.
Alchemy has five essence bubbles; orange gives red essence based on total warrior levels.
Green essence bubble scales with total archer levels and purple essence bubble with mage levels.
Yellow essence gain bubble isn't increased by anything.
Essence chapter bubble boosts all essences based on tome completion: 12% per 2000 points above 5000; about 120% for him.
Some talents require essences: crop chapter needs purple essence smarter spells white essence and ninja looter blue essence.
Ladybug serum vial gives white essence gain and gibbed drink vial gives summoning experience.
World 3 MSA totalizer if unlocked in Jade Emporium gives more essence based on total waves.
Lab spiritual growth gives XP multiplier to all world 6 skills.
Slab bonus crop depot bonuses and Jade Emporium give indirect bonuses to world 6 skills.
Sticky bun meal gives all summoning essence gain and potato meal gives summoning exp.
Very small bonus from shiny pets in breeding.
Two breeding pets give summoning experience based on their level.
Slab gives more essence based on items found; 2504% for him.
Winds lantern can double all summoning winner bonuses (not displayed); pick up as soon as you can though fairly late in Jade Emporium.
Summoner table winner bonus gives 13.73x all essence gain but across several wins.
Jade Emporium upgrades MSA expander and essence confetti are important to unlock for MSA totalizer and slab bonuses.
Outro and patron plug.
